description: Canonical manifest of environment variables consumed by Supabase Edge Runtime functions in this repository. This is the single source of truth for: (1) the .env.example template, (2) the local env checker (scripts/check-edge-env-local.mjs), (3) the server env checker (scripts/check-edge-env-server.sh), and (4) the CI drift detector (npm run check:edge-env). SECURITY: values are never stored here. Each entry declares only a name, category, required flag, runtime target, aliases, and a human description. A variable marked required=false is only needed when the corresponding provider/platform is enabled.
note_on_injection: Docker Compose .env interpolation (${VAR}) only substitutes values INTO the compose file. It does NOT inject variables into containers automatically. To reach the edge-functions container, variables must be passed via env_file: under the functions service OR explicitly mapped in its environment: block. See docs/EDGE_RUNTIME_ENV_RUNBOOK.md.

variables.name: SUPABASE_URL
variables.description: Base URL of the Supabase API gateway (Kong). Edge functions use this to call back into Postgres/auth.

variables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.description: Service role JWT used by functions for privileged (bypass-RLS) database access.

variables.name: SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
variables.description: Anon/publishable JWT. SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY holds the SAME value and is an alias kept for naming compatibility.

variables.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
variables.description: Alias for SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. At least one of the two MUST be set.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: HMAC secret used to sign/verify Supabase JWTs. SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET is an alias holding the same value.

variables.name: SUPABASE_DB_URL
variables.description: Postgres connection string for direct DB access from functions when needed.

variables.name: OAUTH_STATE_SECRET
variables.description: Secret used to sign/verify OAuth state parameters across all OAuth flows.

variables.name: SITE_URL
variables.description: Public app origin used for redirects/callbacks. PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN is an alias.

variables.name: PUBLIC_APP_ORIGIN
variables.description: Alias for SITE_URL.

variables.name: PUBLIC_API_ORIGIN
variables.description: Public API gateway origin. Defaults to the Supabase URL when unset.

variables.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
variables.description: Supabase project reference id. On self-hosted, use 'self-hosted'.

variables.name: CRON_SECRET
variables.description: Shared secret required to invoke scheduled (cron-triggered) edge functions. Sent by pg_cron as `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>` or `x-cron-secret: <CRON_SECRET>`. Verified by supabase/functions/_shared/cron-auth.ts. Must be a high-entropy random string (>=32 chars). Rotate by updating .env, restarting the functions container, and re-running the manual SQL that rewrites the pg_cron headers.
